result.title: BayesCrop: Real-Time Probabilistic Multi-Crop Video Reframing
result.comment: This paper is accepted by WACV 2027. We plan to publicly release the source code at https://github.com/steven413d/BayesCrop
result.summary: Automatic video reframing is increasingly important for adapting landscape content to heterogeneous display formats. Existing methods typically predict a single deterministic crop, despite the subjective nature of reframing and the presence of multiple plausible regions of interest. We present \textbf{BayesCrop}, a real-time probabilistic framework for multi-crop video reframing. BayesCrop represents crop preferences using a two-component spatially isotropic Gaussian mixture over crop position and scale. Each component defines a representative reframing mode together with its local uncertainty, enabling both dual-view prediction and sampling of additional plausible crop candidates. For efficient video processing, we introduce an anchor-and-propagate strategy that performs neural prediction only on sparse anchor frames and propagates crop trajectories using motion vectors available from the compressed video bitstream. The resulting trajectories can be combined into a single output using a lightweight periodic view-switching strategy. Experiments on LIVE-YT-MC, LIVE-YT-VC++, and a multi-target long-video benchmark demonstrate competitive single-output localization, high multi-crop reference coverage, diverse yet coherent crop hypotheses, and stable perceptual quality. BayesCrop achieves real-time throughput of 112 FPS at the default operating point, while sampling from the learned distributions further improves reference coverage beyond the two representative crop means.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BayesCrop 实时概率多裁剪视频重构框架：用双分量空间各向同性高斯混合建模裁剪位置与尺度的偏好及局部不确定性，并仅在稀疏锚帧做神经预测、借压缩码流运动矢量传播轨迹以支持双视图与额外候选采样。
AI.relevance_reason: 把连续视觉状态表示为带不确定性的混合分布并可采样多假设，加上「稀疏神经计算＋廉价传播」的成本分配，可能为 LVR 的多假设 latent 状态与动态计算预算提供问题表述线索，但任务本身与多模态推理无关，需核查。
